item.title: Home Assistant With ESPhome Bluetooth Proxies
item.description: Extend Home Assistant's Bluetooth range with ESPHome proxies on an ESP32. Connect BLE sensors like SwitchBot thermometers over WiFi without a USB adapter.

item.title: Sonoff ZBMINIL2 Wiring Guide: No Neutral, Keep the Existing Wall Switch
item.description: Wire a Sonoff ZBMINIL2 with no neutral and keep the existing wall switch: terminals, the sleeved blue wire, pairing with Home Assistant and what to check first.

item.title: Feeding My Cat With Home Assistant
item.description: Tired of manually feeding your cat? Learn how to automate your Tuya cat feeder with Home Assistant and ensure your furry friend is always fed on time.

item.title: Using an Amazon FireHD8 as a Home Assistant Dashboard Control Panel
item.description: Using an Amazon Fire HD 8 as a wall-mounted Home Assistant control panel: setup, docking, the pros and cons, and the alternatives I considered.

item.title: Passing Through an NVMe Drive to an ESXi Virtual Machine
item.description: Pass through NVMe drives to ESXi virtual machines via RDM raw device mapping. Enable VM direct storage access to physical NVMe disks for specialised workloads.

item.title: Adding Bluetooth to a VW RCD 300
item.description: Add Bluetooth to a VW RCD 300 head unit with a CD changer adapter. No VCDS coding, wireless music in a Caddy or Transporter without replacing the radio.

item.title: More RTX 3060 Nicehash overclocking
item.description: RTX 3060 NiceHash overclocking settings that reached 48 MH/s in 2021: MSI Afterburner core reduction, memory boost and a fan curve for VRAM temperatures.

item.title: RTX 3060 Nicehash mining overclock settings
item.description: RTX 3060 NiceHash overclock settings from 2021 that reached 44+ MH/s: core clock reduction and memory overclock in MSI Afterburner. Kept for reference.

item.title: Unlock RTX 3060 mining hash rate
item.description: How the 470.05 developer driver unlocked the RTX 3060 mining hash rate in 2021, taking NiceHash from 22 MH/s to 42 MH/s. Kept for historical reference.

item.title: Unraid USB Controller Passthrough - VM hot swap USB
item.description: Pass a USB controller through to an UNRAID VM for hot-swappable USB devices, using an Inateck PCIe card and libvirt device configuration.

item.title: [FIXED] Bose Bluetooth headphones with Windows 10
item.description: Fix poor Bose Bluetooth audio and the microphone feedback loop on Windows 10 by switching from the generic driver to Microsoft A2DP Source.

item.title: How to check if RAM is running in ECC mode
item.description: Check whether your RAM is running in ECC mode on Windows and Linux using dmidecode or WMIC, for servers and workstations.

item.title: How To: Raspberry Pi boot from USB
item.description: Boot a Raspberry Pi 4 from an external SSD over USB by updating the EEPROM bootloader. Faster and more reliable than an SD card.

item.title: AWUS036AC (rtl8812au) driver setup in Kali Linux
item.description: Install Alfa AWUS036AC (rtl8812au) drivers on Kali Linux for monitor mode and packet injection with aircrack-ng, using a manual dkms build.

item.title: [SOLVED] - Running Docker on a Raspberry Pi 4
item.description: Fix Docker install errors on a Raspberry Pi 4 running Raspbian Buster. Resolves the kernel cgroup issue that stops containers starting on ARM boards.

item.title: Using a DHT11 sensor with a raspberry pi
item.description: Connect a DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor to a Raspberry Pi over GPIO and read it in Python, no soldering needed with a pre-made 3-pin sensor.
